headline: Providence man charged after mother and 2-year-old daughter are stabbed
dek: Nelson Blanco faces two counts of assault with intent to commit murder after the Broad Street attack; police say investigators do not believe he knew the victims.
body: A 46-year-old man has been charged after a mother and her 2-year-old daughter were stabbed Wednesday afternoon near Broad Street and Public Street in Providence, a case that sent both victims to a hospital and prompted a public pursuit of the suspect. The child was reported in critical condition Wednesday night, while the mother was expected to recover, according to [The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/10/07/metro/mother-and-toddler-stabbed-south-providence-police-say-ri/).

Providence police identified the defendant as Nelson Blanco. Officers responded to the South Providence area after the stabbing, which local reports placed at about 1:30 p.m. or shortly before 2 p.m. on Wednesday. The [Boston 25 News account](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/suspect-taken-into-custody-after-mother-2-year-old-daughter-stabbed-providence/3KWVJQLMHVDRZESMXVQ6W3O7TU/?outputType=amp) said Police Chief Oscar Perez described the victims as a woman in her late 20s and a 2-year-old girl suffering from stab wounds.

The arrest followed more than an immediate police response. [WCVB](https://www.wcvb.com/article/mother-child-stabbed-providence-rhode-island-october-8/74076432) reported that newly released video showed witnesses chasing a man down a nearby street after the attack. Police said the suspect went into the basement of a home, where he was arrested. The account gives residents a clearer outline of how Blanco was located, but it does not establish what happened inside the residence or how the attack began.

The victims’ medical status has not been described consistently across the early reports because officials were still updating the case. The Globe reported Wednesday night that the toddler was in critical condition and that the mother was expected to be OK. WCVB said Thursday morning that police had not released a new official condition update, while [WHDH](https://whdh.com/news/man-charged-with-stabbing-mother-2-year-old-child-in-providence-ri/) reported that both victims had been taken to a hospital without listing their conditions. NorthEast News is not independently confirming either patient’s status.

Blanco faces two counts of assault with intent to commit murder, one involving the adult victim and one involving the child, according to police information reported by WCVB and WHDH. The other listed charges are assault with a deadly weapon; breaking and entering into a dwelling occupied by a person over 60; possession of a knife during the commission of a crime of violence; and possession of a knife with a blade longer than 3 inches. Those are allegations, not findings of guilt, and Blanco is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

The charging documents’ breaking-and-entering count is listed alongside the stabbing charges, but police have not publicly explained how that allegation relates to the attack. Investigators also said they had no evidence that Blanco knew the mother or child. That leaves the relationship question, the reason for the encounter and the sequence of the violence unresolved. The Globe reported that other children were nearby but were not injured.

The case was scheduled to move into court Thursday, with Blanco expected to be arraigned in Providence District Court at 10 a.m. Police also planned a morning update before the arraignment, according to WCVB. That proceeding should establish the formal charges presented to the court and provide the first public opportunity for information about custody and the next hearing, although it may not resolve the central investigative questions immediately.

The location matters because the incident unfolded on a busy South Providence corridor and witnesses, rather than police alone, were described as helping track the fleeing suspect. Video and witness accounts may become part of the investigation, but their existence does not answer whether the victims were targeted or attacked at random. Detectives still have to reconcile the public footage, statements from people at the scene, medical evidence and the defendant’s account. Until those steps are complete, the most consequential facts remain the injuries, the charges and the unknown motive.
location: Broad Street and Public Street, Providence, Rhode Island
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Providence man charged in mother, toddler stabbing
seoDescription: A Providence man faces two assault-with-intent-to-commit-murder counts after a mother and her 2-year-old daughter were stabbed near Broad and Public streets.
